name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your eyes under the bar and feet planted firmly on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and unrack it over your chest.
Lower the bar under control to your mid-chest while keeping your elbows at about a 45-degree angle.
Press the bar back up to lockout without bouncing off your chest.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set an adjustable bench to a 30-to-45-degree incline.
Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width and unrack over your upper chest.
Lower the bar slowly to your upper chest just below the collarbone.
Drive the bar back up until your elbows are locked.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with dumbbells resting on your thighs, then kick them up as you lie back.
Hold the dumbbells over your chest with palms facing forward.
Lower the weights until they are level with your chest, feeling a stretch.
Press the dumbbells back up together without clanging them at the top.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench set to 30 degrees with a dumbbell in each hand.
Press the dumbbells directly over your upper chest.
Lower them under control to the sides of your upper chest.
Press back up to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above your chest with palms facing each other.
With a slight bend in your elbows, open your arms wide in an arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back together along the same arc.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Set both pulleys to chest or upper-chest height and grab a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a staggered stance with a slight lean.
With slightly bent elbows, sweep your hands together in front of your chest.
Return slowly to the stretched starting position.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles align with your mid-chest.
Grip the handles and press forward until your arms are extended.
Return the weight slowly without letting the stack slam.

name: Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Sit upright with your back against the pad and forearms or hands on the machine arms.
Bring the arms together in front of your chest, squeezing at peak contraction.
Control the return until your chest is stretched.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels and lower your chest toward the floor.
Push through your palms to return to the starting position.

name: Chest Dip
instructions: Support yourself on parallel dip bars and lean your torso slightly forward.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are slightly below your elbows.
Press back up to lockout while maintaining the forward lean.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the barbell over the middle of your feet.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs.
Brace your core, flatten your back, and drive through the floor to stand up with the bar.
Lower the bar back to the floor by hinging at the hips first, then bending the knees.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hold a barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Hinge forward at the hips to roughly a 45-degree torso angle with a flat back.
Pull the bar toward your lower chest/upper abdomen by driving your elbows back.
Lower the bar under control until your arms are fully extended.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Set the barbell on the floor and hinge until your torso is nearly parallel to the ground.
Pull the bar explosively to your lower chest, then lower it completely back to the floor each rep.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back.
Lower yourself all the way down to a full hang with control.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Grip the bar with palms facing toward you at shoulder width.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower down slowly to full arm extension.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at a lat pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pad.
Grip the wide bar outside shoulder-width and pull it down to your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats, then let the bar return smoothly to full overhead stretch.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit with feet braced on the platform and grab the V-bar or straight handle.
Keep your torso upright and pull the handle toward your midsection.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then extend your arms forward under control.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one hand and knee on a flat bench for support while holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your torso.
Lower the dumbbell back down until your lat stretches.

name: Chest-Supported Machine Row
instructions: Adjust the chest pad and sit facing the machine.
Grab the handles and pull them back while keeping your chest firmly against the pad.
Return the handles slowly to full extension.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle the landmine or T-bar machine with knees slightly bent and back flat.
Pull the weight toward your chest by squeezing your upper back.
Lower under control without rounding your lower back.

name: Straight-Arm Lat Pulldown
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley with a straight bar or rope attachment.
Keep your arms nearly straight and sweep the bar down to your thighs using your lats.
Control the return back to eye or overhead level.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Set a cable pulley to upper-chest or face height with a rope attachment.
Pull the rope toward your forehead while flaring your elbows out and externally rotating your shoulders.
Return slowly to full arm extension.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell at upper-chest height.
Brace your glutes and core, then press the bar straight overhead until your arms lock out.
Lower the bar under control back to your upper chest.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench with back support, holding dumbbells at shoulder level.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are nearly locked out.
Lower them back to ear or shoulder level under control.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start with dumbbells in front of your shoulders, palms facing you.
Press overhead while rotating your palms to face forward at the top.
Reverse the rotation as you lower the weights back down.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lower the dumbbells slowly without swinging your torso.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Set a single pulley to the lowest setting and stand sideways to the machine.
Grab the handle with your outside hand and raise your arm out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly back across your body.

name: Rear Delt Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, holding light dumbbells beneath your chest.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Lower slowly to the starting position.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at shoulder height.
Press the handles overhead until your arms are extended.
Lower under control back to the starting position.

name: Barbell Upright Row
instructions: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Pull the bar up along your body by leading with your elbows until upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Lower slowly back down.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Position the barbell across your upper traps and unrack it with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core, push your hips back, and bend your knees until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your mid-foot to stand back up to the starting position.

name: Barbell Front Squat
instructions: Rest the barbell across the front of your shoulders using a clean or cross-arm grip.
Keep your elbows high and torso upright as you squat down to full depth.
Drive straight back up while keeping your chest proud.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Squat down between your knees while keeping your chest upright.
Push through your heels to return to standing.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit on the leg press sled with your back flat and feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Unlock the safeties and lower the sled until your knees reach roughly 90 degrees.
Press the platform away without locking your knees out aggressively.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Position your shoulders under the pads and feet slightly forward on the platform.
Lower yourself as deep as your mobility allows while keeping your heels planted.
Drive back up to the top.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit in the machine with the ankle pad resting just above your feet.
Extend your knees until your legs are straight and squeeze your quads.
Lower the weight slowly back down.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand a couple of feet in front of a bench and place your rear foot behind you on the bench.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your front shin relatively vertical.
Push through your front foot to return to the start.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and step forward into a lunge until both knees are at 90 degrees.
Push through your front foot to step the back leg forward into the next lunge.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold a barbell at hip height with a slight bend in your knees.
Push your hips straight back while lowering the bar along your thighs and shins.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs with knees slightly unlocked.
Hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells close to your legs.
Squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to return upright.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on the leg curl machine with the pad just above your heels.
Curl your heels toward your glutes while keeping your hips pressed into the bench.
Lower the weight slowly back to extension.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Adjust the lap pad securely over your thighs and the ankle pad behind your lower calves.
Pull your heels down and back under the seat as far as possible.
Control the return to full knee extension.

name: Good Morning
instructions: Place a barbell across your upper back like a back squat.
With slightly bent knees and a braced core, hinge at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Drive your hips forward to return upright.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell across your hip crease.
Plant your feet flat and drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower under control.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pause and squeeze, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable pulley and face the machine.
Kick your leg straight back while squeezing your glute, avoiding excessive lower-back arch.
Return slowly to the starting position.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on the platform and shoulders under the pads.
Lower your heels all the way down for a full stretch, then rise onto your toes as high as possible.
Pause at the top and lower slowly.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit with your knees under the pad and balls of your feet on the foot block.
Lower your heels fully, then press up onto your toes and squeeze.

name: Barbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand grip at shoulder width.
Keep your elbows pinned at your sides and curl the bar up to shoulder height.
Lower the bar slowly back to full extension.

name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with the back of your upper arms resting on the pad.
Curl the EZ-bar upward without lifting your elbows off the pad.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing forward or neutral.
Curl the dumbbells up while keeping your upper arms stationary.
Lower slowly back to the start.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides with palms facing each other (neutral grip).
Curl the weights up while maintaining the neutral grip.
Lower under control.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit on a 45-degree incline bench letting your arms hang straight down behind your torso.
Curl the dumbbells up while keeping your elbows back.
Lower slowly to feel a deep bicep stretch.

name: Cable Bicep Curl
instructions: Attach a straight or EZ bar to a low pulley and hold it with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders while keeping your elbows steady.
Lower slowly with constant cable tension.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench, brace your working elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder and squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and grip the barbell roughly shoulder-width apart.
Lower the bar to your lower chest while keeping your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Press back up to lockout.

name: Triceps Rope Pushdown
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and tuck your elbows at your sides.
Press the rope down and spread the ends apart at the bottom to fully contract your triceps.
Return slowly to 90 degrees or slightly above.

name: Triceps Bar Pushdown
instructions: Hold a straight or V-bar attached to a high pulley with elbows tucked.
Push the bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Control the bar back up without letting your elbows flare.

name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ-bar straight above your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead or just behind your head.
Extend your elbows to press the bar back up.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Face away from a low or mid pulley holding a rope overhead.
Keep your elbows pointed forward and extend your arms overhead.
Bend your elbows slowly behind your head for a full stretch.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Sit or stand holding one dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Press the weight back up to lockout.

name: Triceps Bench Dip
instructions: Place your hands on a bench behind you with legs extended forward.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push through your palms to return to the top.

name: Plank
instructions: Support yourself on your forearms and toes with your body in a straight line.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly, holding the position without letting your hips sag.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight.
Raise your legs in front of you until they are parallel or higher, curling your pelvis upward.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel below a high pulley holding a rope beside your head.
Flex your spine to crunch your elbows toward your knees while keeping your hips stationary.
Return slowly under control.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel on a mat holding an ab wheel directly under your shoulders.
Brace your core and roll forward as far as you can without your lower back sagging.
Pull back to the starting position using your abs.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and torso leaned back slightly.
Rotate your torso side to side, tapping or holding a weight near each hip.

name: Farmer's Walk
instructions: Pick up heavy dumbbells or farmer's handles at your sides.
Stand tall with shoulders back and walk briskly for the target distance or time.

name: Barbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your forearms resting on your thighs and palms facing up.
Curl the barbell upward using only your wrists, then lower slowly.

name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width and hike the kettlebell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward explosively to swing the kettlebell up to chest height.
Let the kettlebell fall back into the hip hinge and repeat smoothly.

name: Barbell Clean and Press
instructions: Pull the barbell from the floor and explosively rack it onto your front shoulders.
Brace your core and press the bar overhead to lockout.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders and then to the floor.

name: Thruster
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height and squat down to parallel.
Drive explosively out of the squat and use the momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.

name: Burpee
instructions: Drop your hands to the floor and kick your feet back into a plank.
Perform a push-up, jump your feet back under you, and jump up with arms overhead.

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a resistance band in front of you at shoulder height with arms extended.
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the starting position.

name: Banded Face Pull
instructions: Anchor a resistance band at face height and step back to create tension.
Pull the band toward your face while flaring your elbows out.
Return slowly.

name: Treadmill Run
instructions: Set your desired speed and incline on the treadmill.
Maintain an upright posture and steady stride for your target duration.

name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Strap your feet in and grab the handle with an overhand grip.
Drive with your legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your lower chest.
Extend your arms, hinge forward, and bend your knees to return.

name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Adjust seat height so your knee has a slight bend at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Pedal at your target cadence and resistance.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
instructions: Center a flat bench under the Smith machine bar so it aligns with your mid-chest.
Unlatch the bar, lower it to your chest, and press back up.

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Place the bar on your upper traps with feet slightly forward of the bar path.
Squat down to parallel and drive back up.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with arms straight.
Elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears, pause, and lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Hold heavy dumbbells at your sides with arms straight.
Shrug your shoulders straight up, hold briefly, and lower under control.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie on a 30-degree incline bench holding dumbbells above your upper chest.
Open your arms wide with a soft elbow bend until you feel a stretch, then squeeze back together.

name: Cable Reverse Fly
instructions: Set two pulleys to shoulder height without attachments or with single handles.
Cross your arms to grab opposite cables and pull them out and back, squeezing your rear delts.

name: Back Extension
instructions: Position yourself on a 45-degree hyperextension bench with the pad below your hip crease.
Hinge down with a neutral spine, then squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to return to a straight line.
